Furthermore, infants who receive trophic feedings have no increased incidence of NEC (Oddie et al., 2021). Many clinicians have
adapted variations of this practice; some with a shortened period of trophic feeds, others reserving this practice for the smallest,
most preterm and liable infants while employing advancement of feeds in larger, more stable infants. Once minimal enteral nutri-
